description: Removed three invalid null defaults (Realtime session tracing configuration, ConversationParam, BetaConversationParam). In each case null matches none of the declared alternatives, so the default is invalid; nullability elsewhere and every alternative are unchanged. No replacement default or server behavior was inferred.

The name of the workflow to attach to this trace. This is used to
name the trace in the Traces Dashboard.

The group id to attach to this trace to enable filtering and
grouping in the Traces Dashboard.

metadata.description:
The arbitrary metadata to attach to this trace to enable
filtering in the Traces Dashboard.
